caption:
Skip the chandelier, splurge on lamps. The quiet luxury lighting rule for rooms after dark.

One ceiling source flattens everything under it. Two or three lamps at eye level put pools of warm light through the room, and depth comes back for less money.

Warm bulbs only, 2700K, every socket.

Send this to whoever is pricing a chandelier.
